evidence.limits: whisper.srt not available at coding time; speech coded from burned-in captions (hook at 4 fps, rest at 1 fps, so words between frames may be missed). Caption wording from 8 to 17 s is partly cut by animation fades. Loudness series is mostly quiet (-40 to -54 dB in several stretches), so audio level was not used to infer speech. Who says which line is judged from mouth movement; her lines are not captioned separately. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: A staged couple 'ad' for Portal (his business-and-love programme or community; unclear exactly) filmed in an airline cabin: Matan, in pyjamas next to Livnat under a blanket, explains how Portal changed his life while she half-sleeps and joins in; ends with an on-screen 'link here' gag.
audience: his followers, aspiring business owners and singles interested in love and business
caption_vs_video_note: Caption says 'I just wanted to shoot an ad for Portal 😂🌀 love you @livnat_ur': it signals a humorous ad-style skit, not a real ad, and the video matches that.

opening.first_frame: Livnat lying under a blanket and Matan in matching teal sleepwear on a business-class seat bed, he looks at her with a hand on his chin; a caption 'בוא' sits at lower centre.
opening.s0_1: Captions 'בוא / נשחרר / מהמצלמה' appear one by one (0 to 1.5 s); she looks down and speaks.
opening.s1_3: 'מהמצלמה?' with a question mark (1.75 to 2.25 s), 'כן' (2.5 s), 'סגור...' (3 s): an exchange.
opening.s3_5: At 4 s he turns to the camera and speaks directly: 'כשאני נכנסתי' (4.25 s), 'העסקים' (5 s).
opening.visual_hook: A couple in pyjamas in an airplane cabin whispering about 'letting go of the camera', as if filmed by accident.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0 s: 'בואו נשחרר מהמצלמה' (0 to 1.2 s), a short exchange (1.5 to 3.2 s), then he addresses the camera 'כשאני נכנסתי לעולם העסקים, החלום שלי תמיד היה לשבת במחלקת עסקים עם אהבת חיי' (4.2 to 10.2 s); machine transcript
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: never stated (the product 'לפורטל' first appears at 16 s)
opening.first_sentence_standalone: no: opens mid-conversation ('בוא נשחרר מהמצלמה?') with no topic or claim
opening.works_without_sound: partly: captions give the words, but the product only appears at 16 s

visual.ui_interference: Captions at about 70% height (some at 75% in the later part), inside the bottom 35% zone, so they may sit under Instagram's caption overlay.

editing.edit_function: Clarity and humour: no cuts at all; the captions appear word by word with size changes and emoji and drive the pacing.
pacing_changes: t=0 to 4s: one-word captions every 0.25 to 0.5 s
t=18 to 47s: full-phrase captions every 1 to 2 s
t=48 to 56s: the kiss and slow captions
editing.ending: Last 8 s: 'חשבתי ש...', 'אלייך הכול קשור', a kiss and 'אותך (מאוד) ❤️', then a close selfie with a single caption 'לא' at 55 s.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the 'link is not related' gag and the kiss ending reward the full watch; no loop.

sound.delivery: Machine transcript has speech in most of the video (0 to 55.9 s) in short bursts with long gaps (11 to 12.7 s, 21.7 to 24.3 s, 37.8 to 38.8 s, 51.3 to 54.7 s); several lines garbled (marked unclear).
sound.sync: Captions track his speech word by word in the first seconds; later phrase captions appear in bursts of 1 to 2 s; the kiss at 51 s breaks the caption rhythm.

text.rtl_notes: Hebrew RTL correct; the blue swirl logo is inline at the beginning of 'לפורטל' and 'הפורטל' captions; ellipses sit on the wrong side in some lines ('סגור...').

story.setup: Couple in an airplane say 'let us forget the camera' and he starts speaking about his entry into business.
story.stakes: Light: whether the joking ad convinces her.
story.progression: Per the machine transcript: a first take of the 'dream' line (4.2 to 10.2 s) breaks off at 11 s ('והיום...'); an argument that 'זה פרסומת לפורטל' follows (about 12.7 to 21.7 s, partly unclear); a second take 'החלום שלי היה לשבת במחלקת עסקים וליהנות מהכסף שהרווחתי' (26.4 to 32.6 s), 'שבע שנים אחרי שנכנסתי' (32.8 to 34.8 s), then the love dream and 'ובזכות הפורטל...' (38.8 to 43.7 s), then the link gag 'תלחצו כאן' (about 46.9 s) and a kiss. Transcript unclear at 12 to 22 s and 47 to 51 s.
story.payoff: A joking invite to a link ('כאן'), the punchline 'אני לא קשורה' / 'הלינק זה לא קשור', and a kiss.

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 32 comments, not representative. 9 comments are the single word 'יפן' and 1 'פורטל' (keyword entries, apparently for a Japan travel vlog and for Portal as listed in his own pinned-style comment).
